title: Tokyo Marathon 2027 — race information and course page
claims: The official outline page is now headed 'Tokyo Marathon 2027 Race Information' and names the event Tokyo Marathon 2027.
The 2027 race date is Sunday, 7 March 2027; the marathon starts at 09:10 with a 7-hour limit and the wheelchair marathon starts at 09:05 with a 2-hour 30-minute limit.

The 2027 course runs from the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building via Suidobashi, Ueno-hirokoji, Kanda, Nihombashi, Asakusa Kaminarimon Gate, Ryogoku, Monzen-nakacho, Ginza, Tamachi and Hibiya to Tokyo Station/Gyoko-dori Ave., and is certified by JAAF, AIMS and World Athletics.
The 2027 entry fee is JPY 19,800 for domestic participants and USD 230 for international participants; registration opens on 31 July 2026 and donation/charity entry opened on 24 June 2026.
Packet pick-up for 2027 runs on 4–6 March 2027 at Tokyo Big Sight South Exhibition Halls; there is no race-day pick-up.
The 2027 Events field lists only the Marathon and Wheelchair Marathon; the 10.7 km event shown on the 2026 page is not listed.
The 2027 course page's expected-passing-time table starts at 09:10 and ends at 16:10 at 42.195 km, and its 'Download the Course Map' link still points to a PDF named illustmap_2026en.pdf.
